label: Block majority
title: Under block majority, 22 rules close, 14 by commuting and 8 by collapse, and the history cost grows with the ring
kind: Exact audit of the first non-linear observation, with a coset-free refinement census
summary: Three-cell majority as an observation closes exactly 22 rules at every ring 6 to 12: the 14 rules that commute exactly with rule 232 and 8 whose successors always have a constant majority field. The affine rules other than constants, identity, shifts and their complements do not close. The refinement depth reaches 16 at ring 12 and grows with the ring.
takeaway: The first non-linear coarse-graining sorts rules by commutation and collapse, not by complement response, breaks the affine rules' safety, and has a memory cost that grows with the ring inside the tested range.
